mappingDelta: MappingRevalidationRequiredSourceIds contains only a still-current SAME SourceId whose UsageRevision increased. If the same Apply creates a new generation/SourceId, the old ID is revoked and the new ID is initially unmapped by future adapter policy; the new ID is not included in this usage-only delta even if usage also increased.
scope: Identity-only registry; this clarification does not implement mapping or authorize calibration/flight.
